def hidden_rule_fn(state):
    # strand-sum rule: (last-A + last-B) % 8
    # A-strand = even indices, B-strand = odd indices
    # For a state of length 2: last-A = state[0], last-B = state[1]
    last_A = state[-2]  # second-to-last element (even index)
    last_B = state[-1]  # last element (odd index)
    new_val = (last_A + last_B) % 8
    return state + [new_val]
